ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Profile.Name <>"System Administrator"&& (ISCHANGED(Onboarding_Stage__c) && CASE( Onboarding_Stage__c , "Handoff",1, "Training Complete", 2, "1st Check-In Complete",3, "2nd Check-In Complete",4, "Onboarding Complete",5, "Onboarding Abandoned",6,0)-1 <> CASE(PRIORVALUE(Onboarding_Stage__c) , "Handoff",1, "Training Complete", 2, "1st Check-In Complete",3, "2nd Check-In Complete",4, "Onboarding Complete",5, "Onboarding Abandoned",6,0) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Onboarding_Stage__c, "Handoff")) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Onboarding_Stage__c, "Onboarding Abandoned")))
